scope: cloud-test.makodb.com; single deployed Mako data-plane instance; authenticated loopback benchmark

deployment.temporaryCredential: retired; local and guest secret files removed
deployment.browserSmoke: Published Rational reloaded, populated transaction list and showed active synchronization

benchmark.transport: Authenticated service HTTP on VM loopback; sequential then 8 concurrent requests; same record
benchmark.limitations: Small sequential before/after samples, not a sustained load qualification. Sequential tail latency did not improve. Cache, background load and sync-write latency may affect results.

ioObservation.limitation: Observation after deployment, not a controlled comparison against the earlier busy full-scan incident.

accountingReconciliation.mode: Bounded incremental bootstrap; prior recorded usage retained until ready
accountingReconciliation.note: Single I/O or large value can exceed the soft time/byte budget. Reconciliation yields to active writers.
